heading_contract_preflight: Before CLI launch, emit a status-only contract listing the required headings and category count rules.
Require exact headings to be visible in the prompt template before launch.
Keep this as a receipt/checklist, not a raw prompt or raw lane response publication.
prestart_receipt: Write a planned-start receipt before runner files are created and before child process launch begins.
Use the planned-start receipt to distinguish launcher foreground timeout from sibling-output readiness.
Keep process IDs, temp paths, commands, stdout, stderr, and raw lane text redacted.
